Welcome

Where core values and nurturing go hand-in-hand

Step into a world where education meets compassion, and learning goes beyond the books. A place where lifelong friendship begins and the future is bright.

— Executive Chairman

With over a century of quality education, our boarding school empowers every student to explore, discover and excel — fostering academic excellence, character development and global citizenship.

Read our story

Vision & Mission

What Anjuman-I-Islam stands for

I

Vision

To enrich lives and develop model citizens through inclusive, globally competitive, quality education.

II

Mission

To create and nurture educational and social institutions with special focus on women and marginalized sections of society.

Our goals to 2030

Three stages, one campus

Primary · High School · Jr. College

English-medium education from primary through HSC, in one residential community.

Primary

Foundations in reading, numeracy, values and curiosity — quizzes, spell bee and early activities.

High School · SSC

Unit tests, half-yearly and preliminary exams, practicals and Std X board preparation.

Jr. College · HSC

HSC preparation with practicals, Prelim II and integrated entrance coaching.
